نلتصق (form VIII)
# نَلْتَصِقُ (naltaṣiqu) /nal.ta.sˤi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَصَقَ (iltaṣaqa)
# نَلْتَصِقَ (naltaṣiqa) /nal.ta.sˤi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَصَقَ (iltaṣaqa)
# نَلْتَصِقْ (naltaṣiq) /nal.ta.sˤiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِلْتَصَقَ (iltaṣaqa)
